All Members, 
 
Change in Underlying Name & Symbol of ICICI Prudential Life Insurance Company Limited 
 
Members of the Exchange are hereby informed that the name and trading symbol of the following company 
shall be changed w.e.f. October 23, 2026. 
 
Old Symbol New Symbol Old Name of the company New Name of the company 
ICICIPRULI ICICILIFE ICICI Prudential Life Insurance Company Limited ICICI Life Insurance Limited 
 
Consequently, all contracts in the security would be traded under the new symbol , w.e.f. October 23, 2026. 
 
 
 
For and on behalf of 
National Stock Exchange of India Limited
